Your agency's pipeline fits on one screen. Do you look at it every morning?

Most sales meetings in real estate start with "how's it going?"
A better start is four numbers.

A 10-minute morning review for sales managers in Qatar:

• New leads
How many came in yesterday, and from where: Property Finder, Qatar Living, Property Oryx, Meta lead forms, Google Ads or your website.

• First response time
How long new leads waited for a reply. This is the number to fix first.

• Unassigned leads
Any lead without a named agent is a lead nobody owns. Clear it before 10am.

• Conversion rate
Are leads moving through stages to viewings and deals, or stalling?

In OneLinker CRM these sit on the manager dashboard, next to active listings, viewings and WhatsApp clicks. Each team has its own manager, so every manager sees their own pipeline.
